content:
Lina: Quick PR opened to add a tiny "egress sanity" section to the Private/VPC install guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2834
Omar: 👍 can you include a one-line nftables and an iptables fallback? Many customers still use both.
Lina: Yep. Keeping it minimal. Also adding a short note about preserving SNI when chaining proxies.
Priya: nftables (ubuntu22 LTS):
```
add table inet redwood_egress
add chain inet redwood_egress input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }
add rule inet redwood_egress input ct state established,related accept
add rule inet redwood_egress input ip saddr 10.100.0.0/24 tcp dport 23456 accept
```
Priya: iptables fallback:
```
iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 10.100.0.0/24 --dport 23456 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
```
Hank: Add a systemd override suggestion for the kms-proxy: Restart=on-failure + RestartSec=8 and LimitNOFILE 65536.
Maya: editorial: standardize headings to uppercase HSM and prefer the phrase "Transit Gateway" consistently. Also avoid real ARNs or PKCS11 slot IDs.
Lina: Good catches. I'll scrub any identifiers and run a heading sweep.
Omar: For air-gapped verify, include both GPG and openssl checks: `gpg --verify bundle.tar.gz.sig bundle.tar.gz` and `openssl dgst -sha256 -verify pub.pem -signature bundle.sig bundle.tar.gz`.
Priya: Also add a tiny curl healthcheck example that uses --resolve for offline DNS: `curl -v --resolve hsm:23456:10.100.0.12 https://hsm/health`
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck -> docs/private/egress.md '#sni-preserve' missing (job #912)
Lina: Pushed a commit to add the anchor and a short paragraph describing when to use TLS passthrough vs termination.
DocsBot: CI: linkcheck passed, linter warnings only.
Hank: Can we backport the snippets to release/1.2.x? Some support tickets reference that installer.
Lina: Yes will add a backport commit and a changelog line: "docs: add egress sanity checks, nftables/iptables examples, systemd hint, offline verify (backported to v1.2)"
Maya: Security note: don't recommend storing private keys directly in env files; point to KMS or file-based TLS_KEY_PATH with chmod 600.
Lina: Replaced examples accordingly. Thanks everyone. Merging after one final review.
Priya: LGTM
DocsBot: PR merged and backported to release/1.2.x. Thread closed.
